findings.title: [P1] Include the source payloads referenced by the manifest
findings.body: Both manifest rows name `.java.txt` resources beneath the recipe template root, but neither resource is included in the exact seven-file bundle. `M3GpuToolJoinManifest.load` opens every non-`KEEP` fourth-column resource and verifies its postimage before Replay can plan, check, or apply, so this package will fail with `cannot read recipe resource` for the first target. Add both exact pinned payload files to the published bundle (or point the rows to resources actually shipped with it).

overall_explanation: The metadata is internally aligned on revisions, hashes, scope, and qualification boundaries, but the executable recipe omits both source resources required by its manifest. Consequently none of the documented plan/check/apply workflows can load the recipe.
